principle: A planted long tool may temporarily own the root before flight: run-in foot support becomes a ground-anchored shaft, hips overtake the tip, support is released into one ballistic arc, and landing debt is paid through a one-foot crush plus a chase-step re-entry while the tool lags as secondary mass.

keys.label: RUN_IN_LOW_CARRY
keys.causal_role: Low forward run-in with the staff carried behind the left hip; right foot owns the root while the left knee reaches, establishing asymmetric horizontal commitment.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right-foot run-in; root low and forward

keys.label: LEFT_STAMP_POLE_PLANT
keys.causal_role: Left foot stamps under the pelvis as the staff tip bites far ahead; hands split on the shaft and torso folds toward the future support line before any foot leaves.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: two supports establish a diagonal force triangle

keys.label: FEET_RELEASE_POLE_LOAD
keys.causal_role: Both feet release only after the planted shaft has taken load; pelvis rises and passes forward while the rear leg whips backward and the tool tip remains world-fixed.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: ground ownership transfers from foot to tool tip

keys.label: VAULT_HIP_OVERTAKE
keys.causal_role: The pelvis overtakes the planted tip line while the rear leg lashes high and one shoulder drops; tool support remains fixed but the body rotates around it rather than climbing vertically.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: curved tool-owned vault arc; horizontal speed converts upward

keys.label: TOPSIDE_TOOL_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: Hands release the planted support after the hips clear it; the body leaves on a forward-up tangent while the shaft lags beneath and behind instead of teleporting with the torso.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support break to ballistic arc; tool becomes free secondary mass

keys.label: FORWARD_HOLLOW_APEX
keys.causal_role: Apex is a hollow forward-facing silhouette, not a hang: lead knee folds under the chest, trail leg stays long, and released staff continues its own lagging rotation.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: brief non-hover apex; forward velocity survives

keys.label: DESCENT_TOOL_CLEAR
keys.causal_role: Gravity wins immediately; the torso pitches down and the hands drive the free shaft backward/up to clear the landing lane while the root keeps falling.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: gravity-earned descent; local tool task cannot add root lift

keys.label: LEFT_HEEL_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: Left heel drops under and slightly ahead of the falling COM while the right leg remains folded; staff is high and rearward, forcing a narrow first landing rather than a poster split.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: precontact foot path steepens; root still down-forward

keys.label: LEFT_HEEL_FIRST_CATCH
keys.causal_role: Left heel becomes the first trusted support while the root continues down and forward; the right knee still trails and the staff head keeps overtaking behind the body.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: first support acquired without instant COM arrest

keys.label: CROSS_KNEE_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: The left support stays planted while pelvis falls to its lowest point; right knee crosses behind the support line and the shaft overshoots across the back, paying vertical and angular debt asymmetrically.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: deep one-foot compression; forward speed nearly arrested

keys.label: REBOUND_STAFF_LAG
keys.causal_role: Ground reaction lifts and turns the root before the long tool catches up; the chest opens while the staff still crosses behind, creating visible secondary lag instead of reverse interpolation.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: small rebound up-forward; tool remains late

keys.label: RIGHT_STEP_TAKEOVER
keys.causal_role: Right foot takes support ahead as the left foot releases; pelvis travels through rather than recentering, and the staff rotates toward a carry position one beat late.

keys.label: CHASE_STEP_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: The chase step deliberately overshoots the landing address; free left leg and staff both trail while the torso leans past the new support, preserving recovery debt.

keys.label: DISPLACED_RUN_REENTRY
keys.causal_role: Left foot lands farther forward into a running re-entry while the staff settles low behind; body is still pitched and displaced, never reset to the initial carry pose.
keys.motion_arc_root_note: stable but still moving re-entry at a new address

revision.novelty_boundary: not Airborne017 off-axis tool landing; not Airborne018 rider/chassis counterpitch; not Airborne019 hook catch; not Airborne020 stall-flare; not Airborne021 wrong-foot whiff; not Airborne022 ceiling palm-brace; not Airborne023 overhead pendular release. A024 uniquely transfers root authority from foot to planted tool before flight, then removes tool support before apex and pays landing via one-foot crush + chase step.

rounds.defect: planted/tool-carry shaft was visibly disconnected from the hands, so temporary tool support read as a detached prop rather than causal root ownership
rounds.correction: realign authored tool endpoints and K2/K3 grip coordinates so the shaft visibly passes through the hands while its planted tip remains fixed; preserve hand ownership through free-flight carry

rounds.judgment: specific foot-to-tool support transfer, fixed-tip vault arc, earned release, non-hover apex, gravity descent, left-heel first catch, deep one-foot crush, rebound with tool lag, chase-step overshoot, displaced run re-entry

noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE+FUNCTION+CONTEMPT PASS: the vertical shaft pivot, hips-over-tip silhouette, hollow apex, low one-foot crush, and staff-lag chase step form a causal performance rather than a prop reskin; distinct from Airborne017–023.
